prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the silicone container from workbench to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether two silicone containers are on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Two translucent white plastic wash/squeeze bottles stand upright, side by side, on a white plate mounted to an aluminium extrusion frame. Each has a bright red screw cap with an angled bent dispensing spout; both caps are in place and the spouts point left/down-left. The left bottle carries a green band near its shoulder, the right bottle a blue band. Both appear to hold clear or colourless liquid, filled to roughly the mid-upper body. At right, a white circular recess or holder sits empty in the plate. Behind, two black vertical rods rise from a dark square base plate speckled with debris. Metal screws and hex fittings dot the white mounting plate; pale walls and lighting are in the background.
observations: The photo shows two translucent plastic wash/squeeze bottles with red spouted caps (green- and blue-banded) on the workbench plate, not silicone containers; one circular holder position is empty. No silicone containers are visible, so the expected two silicone containers are not present.
